# Ashe MUN

> Ashe MUN is a premier Model United Nations conference held June 24–25, 2026 in India. Deliberate with Clarity. Debate with Passion. Deliver with Purpose.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Conference overview, countdown, key information, and registration.
- [About](/about): The story behind Ashe MUN, mission, and vision.
- [Committees](/committees): The eight committees, agendas, and difficulty levels.
